definition: [ שָׁחַק ] verb rub away, beat fine, pulverize (so Arabic , worn garment, thin clouds ; Aramaic שְׁחַק , pilverize ; Ecclus שחק Eccl 6:36 is go often (wear by treading), Str compare iter terere ); — Qal Perfect 3 plural אֲבָּנִים שָֽׁחֲקוּ מַיִם Job 14:19 waters rub away stones ; 2 masculine singular וְשָׁחַקְתָּ֫ Exod 30:36 ( P ; of pulverizing incense, see דקק Hiph`il ); figurative, accusative of foes, Imperfect 1 singular suffix וְאֶשְׁחָקֵם 2Sam 22:43 (||) = Ps 18:43 .
